$schema_comment: Regression rules enforced by the bench harness after every ./build.sh bench run. Each rule fires once per (length_bucket, error_bucket) cell. The benchmark process exits non-zero when any rule is violated and the offending cells are listed both in the console table and in report.json under the top-level "violations" array.
$tolerance_pct_comment: Tolerance applied to every comparison. 'equal_to' rules pass when |actual - baseline| / baseline <= tolerance_pct. For 'faster_by_at_least_pct' rules with value_pct=8, the rule passes whenever the speed-up lands in [value_pct - tolerance_pct, +inf), i.e. 6% or more.

rules.comment: Production SIMD-DP minimizer must be ≥ 5% faster than minimap2 DP.
Block aligner SIMD-DP path is the optimisation target — must be ≥ 8% faster than minimap2 DP.
Scalar reference path must match minimap2 DP wall-clock within tolerance.
RMQ chaining path must match minimap2 RMQ wall-clock within tolerance.
Production SIMD path must match minimap2 DP position accuracy.
Block aligner SIMD path must match minimap2 DP position accuracy.

wildcard_rules.comment: All bioseq algorithms must match minimap2 DP position accuracy unless an explicit rule above overrides them.
